title: Database query in request loop
summary: A Flask route performs repeated database queries while iterating over records.
rationale: This creates N+1 behavior and amplifies latency, compute, and database load as result size grows.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Batch queries, eager load related data, or reshape the query so the route performs bounded database work.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
